how.lead: A missed call is a lost customer – most never call back. That's the feeling Dialogbot takes away: standing on a ladder or with a client in the chair, hearing the phone ring and not being able to pick up.

steps.title: The customer calls – as always
steps.text: On your own number. If you're busy or closed, Dialogbot picks up within two seconds and introduces itself as your receptionist.

steps.title: It answers and books
steps.text: Based on the services, prices and opening hours you have approved. It never guesses. If the customer needs an appointment, it finds a free slot in your calendar and sends an SMS.

steps.title: You get a message
steps.text: Name, number and what it was about – by SMS or email straight away, plus a summary report every day. If there's something it can't handle, it takes a message for you.

items.title: Answers the phone
items.text: Around the clock, with a voice you choose. It's honest that it's a digital assistant if the customer asks.

items.title: Books appointments
items.text: Finds free slots in Google Calendar or Microsoft 365, books, moves and cancels – and sends a confirmation by SMS.

items.title: Answers on your website
items.text: The same knowledge as a web chat on your site: customers asking about prices and opening hours get an answer straight away – evenings too. One line of code and it's live.

items.title: Calls customers
items.text: Follows up on quotes or sends service reminders – only to customers who have said yes. The minutes come out of the package; then {pCallAnswered} per answered call + {pMinute} per minute.

features.note: Everything it says is based on knowledge you have approved – and it shows you every change first: before → after, “Approve?”.

price.whyTitle: Why we cost more than a chatbot
price.whyText: A cheap chatbot answers with whatever it picked up from the internet. Dialogbot only answers from knowledge you have approved, and shows you every change first: before → after, “Approve?”. It can also book, move and cancel appointments in your calendar and send SMS confirmations – and you get a message about every call. That's why it costs more than an answering machine.

faq.q: Does it sound like a robot?
faq.a: No. Dialogbot speaks naturally and always introduces itself as a digital receptionist, so the customer knows who they're talking to. Listen to the demo above.

faq.q: Do I need to change my phone number?
faq.a: No. You keep your number and forward it – either always, or only when you don't pick up. We show you how in step 3.
Then it takes a message with name, number and what it's about, and sends it to you straight away. It never guesses at prices or appointments you haven't given it.
No. The fixed price can be cancelled month to month, and pay-per-enquiry has no fixed cost.
